caption: Most people plan by how loud requests feel instead of real impact. This carousel provides a simple 5-prompt method to turn a messy backlog into clear priorities. Which task would you rank first today? #AIforWork #Productivity #Founders #Entrepreneurs

slides.title: Stop prioritising by urgency
slides.body: Problem: planning by urgency wastes energy. Five prompts promise clearer priorities, better estimates, and outcomes.

slides.title: 1. Diagnose impact vs effort
slides.body: Task: rank tasks by Impact and Effort (1-5) from your backlog; Output: numbered list with Task, Priority, Rationale.

slides.title: 2. Reframe to outcomes
slides.body: Task: rewrite each task as an outcome with a measurable success metric; Output: list of Task to Outcome (metric).

slides.title: 3. Build 7-day plan
slides.body: Task: create 7-day plan with daily focus and time blocks; include hours placeholder {hours_per_day}; Output: Day X: Focus, Hours.

slides.title: 4. Check feasibility & blockers
slides.body: Task: map dependencies and blockers; Output: list blockers, required inputs, and mitigation steps.

slides.title: 5. Guardrail-driven refinement
slides.body: Task: set if-then guardrails for changes in constraints; Output: new ranking and plan adjustments if constraint changes.

slides.title: Takeaway
slides.body: Takeaway: outcomes trump urgency; use the five prompts to turn a messy backlog into a focused plan.
